description.value: Saltwater Bakery & Provisions is an open-concept artisan bakery located in the scenic Cow Bay neighbourhood of Prince Rupert, operated as a Gitxaała enterprise. It offers freshly made sourdough and artisanal breads, sweet and savoury pastries, signature desserts, handcrafted ice cream, and a curated selection of local products from across Northern BC. For touring cyclists arriving in Prince Rupert, it is a distinctive stop for quality baked goods and regional provisions in a welcoming bakeshop atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Saltwater Bakery is a real, operating business at 5 Cowbay Road, Prince Rupert, BC, offering artisanal breads, pastries, desserts, ice cream, and local artisan provisions. The website provides an address not present in OSM tags, which I have used as the address field. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no address; address '5 Cowbay Road, Prince Rupert, BC' was taken from the website and should be verified.
No phone number found in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating artisan bakery and provisions shop in Prince Rupert's Cow Bay with a confirmed website; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and local products.
